answer: Re-attestations are stored in raven and echo lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, which means holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the lagoon graph. A farm of 3906 identities would post 1022 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
